description: A free digital painting application (Krita 6.1 prealpha, KDE nightly CI build)
notes: Krita Next (6.1.0-prealpha) nightly build from https://cdn.kde.org/ci-builds/graphics/krita/master/windows/ - bleeding edge, for testing only.
The CI directory only keeps the newest builds, so this URL disappears once a newer nightly lands; the cached download keeps working.
Settings and resources live in %APPDATA%\krita and in the ResourceDirectory set in kritarc, shared with any other Krita install on this machine.
Shortcut uses the unbranded classic Krita icon (scripts/krita-default.ico); the running window/taskbar icon is overridden by the nobeta_icon pykrita plugin.
